verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published guidance on choosing an entity type or jurisdiction. The Lowenstein x Clerky page describes a workflow for incorporating a Delaware C corporation. The IP & Tech Transactions page says the firm 'advise[s] on company formation'. Both are adjacent formation services, not comparative guidance on Delaware C-corp vs UK Ltd vs GmbH/UG vs Indian Pvt Ltd, and nothing shows coverage of non-US jurisdictions.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm publishes guidance on choosing entity type and jurisdiction of incorporation (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG, Indian Pvt Ltd) appropriate to my market
